_about: Error codes of the guardian API (user-management) and the progress service (AGB-1084). Same envelope as the shared registry: { code, message }. Never removed, only deprecated.

codes.description: Five wrong parent PINs: the account and the device are locked for 15 minutes.
The action needs the profile's consent, which has not been given for the current version.
A student-scoped token called an adult endpoint.
Events are refused: consent for the profile is not active.
The caller is not the guardian of this student.
The event failed validation (unknown kind, wrong detail, profile mismatch). Per event inside a batch answer.
More than BATCH_MAX (50) events in one request.
The changes cursor is older than the service keeps; the device must reload positions.
The parent's data export is larger than the service builds in one request (more than 20,000 events); ask support for a file.
A path or query parameter is malformed (knowledgeId, sectionId, studentId or tz). Checked after access; the value is never echoed.
Per event (2.23.0): a self learner sent a kind other than `note`. Permanent: the app drops the event.
Per event (2.23.0): the learner's own record was erased; nothing can be saved for this account again. Permanent: the app drops the event and clears its queue.

Per event (2.23.0): the event uses a field or value this service version does not know (version skew, for example a newer app). Not permanent: the app keeps the event, moves on and retries after an update.
